searchText: @clientdevs, Dencun devnet 10 has been stable the last day. We've been feeding it a stable number of blobs, targeting ~3 and not overloading the mempool. Considering this is the best case scenario for a network, find our detailed analysis of it here: https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/dencun-devnet-10-analysis ^ There's sections on resource usage, links to dashboards and blob/block/attestation timing analysis. Have a look and let us know if you have questions and if you want us to gather any more data. Considering the network is stable, we'll start spamming it, adding blobber and a few more chaotic things to collect more data on the worst case network behaviour. https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/dencun-devnet-10-analysis#Blob-performance-per-client-pair still basically function of EL rather than CL Is there builder on devnet-10? Yes. `http://0xa55c1285d84ba83a5ad26420cd5ad3091e49c55a813eee651cd467db38a8c8e63192f47955e9376f6b42f6d190571cb5@mev-api.dencun-devnet-10.ethpandaops.io:9062` very nice, are all the clients testing it? only lodestar right now We seem to have found a bug with mev-boost so waiting on a fix for that then I plan to roll out with other clients too amazing report! Was it prepared during the blob & transaction spamming? thanks 😄 yeah its prepared after a whole day of consistent blobs, most slots have 1-4 blobs in them. we'll do proper spamming now and bump those numbers up. consider it a baseline analysis thanks, this is awesome. Going through it now. Could you give a heads up before you start blob spam? yeah sure, anything specific you want to check before? setting up a local node that's all 😅 <@199561711278227457> didn't really get https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/dencun-devnet-10-analysis#BlockBlob-analysis what does "time from the first blob included in a block" mean?! once we get the first blob expected for a block, we start a timer till the last one. once we get the last blob, we should have everything needed to verify the block, otherwise we're missing data for verification. cc <@181594452228308992> ahh okay gotcha. So for num_blobs = 0/1, the time would be 0 right? also, how are you getting the blob arrival metrics on the sentry? is it the sse event? Yup yeah its an sse event that's why we dont have all clients on there yet. lodestar added support yesterday and we haven't rolled it out yet. ^ https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/350 can i spam more blobs now? are you also doing the sending duplicate blob sidecars test? if so, could you give us a bit to add some logging for that? yeah that'll happen via blobber, having some issues initializing it but will ask before i spin it up sounds good then, will ping once we merge the additional logging in lighthouse cc <@607055410104500244> <@792822129019584562> this is my data from 3 devnet10 nodes https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_OeDO-VQ5IBjXWua_L3W6w_Qzspny3q0RzccGkMYZ54/edit?usp=sharing in case you are planning to rerun your analysis, might be interesting to compare. where's the data from? 😄 Debug logs from teku (from 3 nodes) we have a blobber ready if you are 😄 super, will dig into this and thanks a ton! these are mean times? ahh i can see the percentile table too actually not really different my my analysis completion mean full import? from the logs it seems that average import is 210mss, so if i remove that 0.95 percentile all blobs "seen" is 1900ms is my interpretation correct? do you know why the only reth pair in the "Blob performance per client pair" chart is `lighthouse/reth`? Did a reth pair fail somewhere? smaller %, so some havent had a chance to propose yet. will crosscheck info 😄 ah we made reth deposits 😄 the validators are still coming online so you might need to wait a bit longer for reth data. curious what could make processing of 5 blobs noticeably slower than of 6 that's on the cl side right? because we notice the same on xatu data yes it is on CL, reading it from <@504202741933932544>'s document it's just lack of examples <@425572898787426305> ah i see, makes sense Indeed! Makes sense now, so statistics for 5 blobs isn't representative upped the blob spam numbers on devnet-10, adding blobber to a few nodes now 😄 can you run https://github.com/sigp/lighthouse/tree/devnet-10 on lighthouse nodes when you get a chance? 😅 yeah sure 😄 do you have an image built or should i trigger a build? don't have an image sorry! :/ no worries, it'll take a bit to build but ill run it once its out 😄 Its now rolled out. just to confirm from xatu side here is the last 24hrs, less than 100 blocks had 5 blob sidecars

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
@clientdevs, Dencun devnet 10 has been stable the last day. We've been feeding it a stable number of blobs, targeting ~3 and not overloading the mempool. Considering this is the best case scenario for a network, find our detailed analysis of it here:
https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/dencun-devnet-10-analysis

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
^ There's sections on resource usage, links to dashboards and blob/block/attestation timing analysis. Have a look and let us know if you have questions and if you want us to gather any more data. 

Considering the network is stable, we'll start spamming it, adding blobber and a few more chaotic things to collect more data on the worst case network behaviour.
